agent.first_message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, Rechnungswesen. Wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?

_notes.language: Default de. The conversation initiation webhook overrides it per call from the caller's stored preference, falling back to German (FR-033a). Overrides must stay enabled or that webhook cannot set it.
_notes.first_message: The German fallback greeting required by FR-033a when the caller's number is not recognised. Once the conversation initiation webhook exists (T076) it overrides this per call with the caller's stored language. It uses no name and does not acknowledge that the number was recognised (FR-033b).
_notes.temperature: Low. This agent reads statuses back to callers and follows a policy; inventiveness is a defect here, not a feature.
_notes.turn_timeout: 10s. Callers checking a banking app for a payment date need thinking time, and the agent explicitly offers to wait.
_notes.system_tools: language_detection for DE/FR/IT/EN, and transfer_to_number for the escalation handoff. Both are configured at the platform level rather than in this file.
_notes.asr: scribe_realtime. The original 'elevenlabs' provider was removed and existing agents migrated; specifying it is now rejected.
_notes.phone_number: +1 656 223 0845 (phnum_5701m1k7hybefhvvh8j28rz577e2), imported from Twilio and assigned to this agent. A number routes to exactly one agent, which is why this project uses its own rather than sharing.
_notes.dynamic_variables: candidate_customer_id defaults to empty so a call can start before the initiation webhook exists. It scopes the identity lookup only and never counts as a verification factor (FR-033b).
